item.title: Guardiome
item.description: Guardiome is a genomics company that gives people easy access to their genome. I worked with them to design branding, the website and its graphics, product renders, and much more.

item.title: Asus Vivobook
item.description: For this project, we needed to composite a screen onto a laptop that an actor was interacting with. Another artist was contracted to rotoscope and track the screens, while my job was to create an animatable replica of the Windows 8 interface as well as other apps like Outlook, Skype, and the default picture viewer. These fake apps had to be dynamic, as I would be adjusting and tweaking animations and content throughout the project.
